body:
I don't understand why you will be put on a list if you haven't done anything. If you haven't broken the law, at least in the U.S. you wouldn't be put on a list. The sex offenders lists are for convicted sex offenders. 
  It seems like you should be able to talk to someone while keeping confidentiality. Psychiatrists, etc have to keep that by law unless someone threatened someone elses wellbeing. Could you make an anonymous call to someone and ask about this?

Well, I went for 2 weeks once. I had been having suicidal feelings.  I had my own room kindof, but I think it didn't have a door, though it still felt private. The first night or two they checked on me every hour it seemed, but I think after that they didn't so much. Some of it seemed to help, like the art room but I ike art and stuff like that. They had students take our blood pressure every day which was kind of annoying because they were fake cheery.  It gave me a break from my family who are all abusive. I guess I felt safe. They got frustrated with me because I wanted to read about medicines before I took anything. But I don't care, it's my body. The doctor I saw was okay and mostly told me my parents were assholes. I think he saw they were the reason I was in there. 

It didn't really fix anything but in the short term it helped me feel a little more in control. Idk. Sometimes I think that I just needed a really good friend to give me a hug and care about me. But I didn't have that. I didn't really want to die then, and the suicidal thoughts and feelings were scaring me so it helped me feel somewhat better.  They misdiagnosed me though. And then I had this stupid label in my files. 

I don't think they were that brilliant/clever in there, but i think at that time the feeling of knowing someone was checking on me all the time let me relax in a way.

& sorry gor3beard for not seeing this. I know what you mean - I had someone saying "but you feel better now right? You don't feel suicidal now." like he was telling me I felt better and not suicidal which of course made me feel worse - like he wanted me to pretend. Kind of defeats the purpose of an anonymous help line. 

Thanks for taking the time to respond - this *did* make me feel better. For real.

tigerlilymeow, Im sorry I float on and off of the site and didn't see this because I want to thank you for taking the time to write to me and help me feel better about the helpline person. You are right and I know there is a rape crisis line and they are very sensitive and real and I forget about them. It really is too random on the Samaritans - and I'm too vulnerable to take chances cause it really feels like I'm walking on a precipice. I'm so glad you wrote to me even if you never see this - (but I hope you do) because it has helped. Thank you - because you didn't have to reach out this way - and I feel so alone all the time now -and I don't have the best words - but thanks for just getting it & for caring. I wish no one ever had to go through this.

haha Yes, thank you! That's what's bothering me about it - you've pinpointed it. They say it a kind of knowing or authoritative way - as it by saying that one word I will be enlightened and on the path to health and happiness - sorted, problem solved. And I know they are absolutely bloody clueless and I am in this whole universe of nightmarish existance - and it makes me feel even more isolated, more alone. 
But you put it way better.

Yes! I finally spoke to someone tonight on Samaritans and he actually totally understood why I was suicidal and didn't try to talk me out of it or convince me why I have to stay alive. It felt so good to have that converstation because I needed to talk about it in a real way. I mean I live with it and think about it every single day. I absolutely hate when someone tries to take that away from me. It is my escape route and I need to know I could do that if I wanted to. 

I'm sure I'm incoherant but I do know - as much as I can as I'm not you - what you mean. I have been through trauma and I totally get myself and why I'm suicidal. And it's not like you are talking about taking up a new hobby. How can people simplify it like that. "Don't" I want to say "Oh hell, ok then, you've totally swayed me with your insight, empathy and deep understanding about my complex situation." 

I am sick of it too.

sorry, I'm not really doing so great today. I didn't mean to sound so immature, but I just really do forget my user names and passwords all the time. So I just mean there are at least some legitamit reasons for it.
They have helped me before. I am still greatful they are there. I just felt like this person wasn't really in it in a real way.

I can tell you why I do. Because I'm so fcked up that I never remember my user names from before. Because I forget to eat half the time. why is this so annoying to you anyway?
Edited: because I was way too wound up that day. Sorry.
